subject: Acme Mutual Action Plan and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Acme Mutual Action Plan and next steps

Hi Jordan and Priya,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the time. As promised I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short evaluation checklist to help structure the next 6 weeks. High-level recap and recommended owners/dates are inline below.

Recap from discovery:
- Primary use case: customer service summarization + routing (50k monthly active conversations)
- Key constraints: PII controls, VPC-only deployment for production, latency SLO 200ms p95 for short prompts

Proposed MAP (attached: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf):
1) Pilot kickoff - Redwood to provision evaluation environment (Dev VPC) — Target owner: Redwood (Rishi) — Target start: 2027-09-27
2) Integration & test (data ingestion + sample prompts) — Owner: Acme (Priya) — Target: 2 weeks from kickoff
3) Perf & quality evaluation (MAP checklist) — Owner: Acme (Jordan) — Target: 10 business days after integration
4) Exec review & procurement — Owner: Acme Procurement — Target: 2027-11-01

Can you confirm the two owners above (Priya for integration, Jordan for quality) and the proposed dates? If those work I can lock the MAP and schedule a 30-min kickoff next week.

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf, redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to adjust the owners/dates to match your internal timing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

https://redwood.com

Per your ask on the evaluation env checklist: Rishi put together a short list (attached in MAP) — key items from our side are:
- A test service account with access to the sample dataset (s3 or GCS)
- A staging VPC peering or temporary VPN for the evaluation instance

If you'd like, we can set a 20-min sync this week to walk Priya through the onboarding steps and get the evaluation env provisioned the same day.

If timing has shifted and this isn't a priority for Q4, a quick note would be helpful so we can reallocate Rishi's capacity.
